Show FPS and Upscaling options.

- Show FPS (Settings > Display, or the in-game menu): a small overlay with the screen frame rate, the game's own frame rate, and NUON speed. The game frame rate is the one that drops when emulation can't keep up; the screen rate stays near 60 because the emulator always delivers a frame every 1/60 s. Games that never flip frames show "-" for game.
- Upscaling (Settings > Display, or the in-game menu):
  - Soft: plain smoothing (as before)
  - Sharp pixels: crisp, evenly sized pixels at any screen size, with no shimmer (replaces the old "4:3 sharp" screen option)
  - Smooth HD: bicubic filtering for a clean, high-resolution look
- NUON games draw their picture in software, so there's no 3D scene to re-render at a higher resolution; upscaling here means better scaling filters.
